_comment: Fixture hosting config for check-seo-surface.js's orphan check. A <loc> with no HTML file on disk is only an orphan if firebase.json ALSO has no redirect or rewrite serving it — the real firebase.json has 21 redirects and 16 rewrites, six of them under /pro (e.g. /pro/landing is a 301, /pro/account-erasure is a Cloud Function), and calling any of those a 404 would fail the build on a URL that resolves fine. Mirrors that shape: one plain redirect, one globbed rewrite to a function.
